# Form font fixture

`fixture.ttf` is the original Contact Sheet test font, copied from that tool's fixtures. Its family is Contact Sheet Fixture; its limited rectangle glyphs are for embedding checks only.

The original fixture font is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal. It may be used, modified, embedded and redistributed for any purpose without attribution. To the extent a public-domain dedication is not effective, permission is granted to do all of those things without restriction. It is provided without warranty. The licence is also in its name table.
